course.title: Welding and Materials Joining Processes
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Suppose you are the senior quality control engineer in a welding company. The company (15) always uses stabilized austenitic stainless steel 321 and 347, to avoid any kind of weld decay. But they are still observing some corrosion attack in the narrow region immediately adjacent to the weld metal. Can you identify why this corrosion attack may be happening? Can you propose two or three solutions that they can try to remedy this?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
